## Where in the spec

Quote the exact text (with section/line reference).

## The ambiguity

Describe the two (or more) interpretations you considered.

## What your implementation chose

Which interpretation did you go with, and why?

## Impact

If both interpretations shipped, what would break? (Interoperability failure? Silent data corruption? Security property loss?)
